message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: bribery (受贿) by the hospital director? Actually the defendant is金某 who gave bribes to a state staff (hospital director). Under Chinese criminal law, giving bribes is "行贿". The defendant gave money to a state functionary for obtaining contracts. So crime: 行贿罪 (bribery). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? He sold medical equipment via companies, but likely legitimate sales. The main illegal act is offering bribes. Also "挪用公款"? No. "受贿" is for recipient, not defendant. So only "行贿罪". Also maybe "职务侵占"? No. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.
